doc.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Unreleased album September Songs with strings
summary: He has an album with the London Symphony, whose tape he is trying to get from Rod McKuen's estate.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Do you have any recorded works that are – what do you call it? – “in the vault”?
Yes I do. I have an album called September Songs: Jon Hendricks with Strings, which I did in London with the London Symphony.
I listened to that the other day.

I’m trying to get in touch with the estate of Rod McKuen to get that tape. But I think something’s happening, because I call Rod’s office, and the lady gives me the same answer every time. I give them the message, and I never get a call back. So I’m not sure what is going on. If I’m in Los Angeles long enough I’m going to make a personal trip down to the office, and I’m going to demand to know what is happening, because he may be ill. If he is, I’d like to know that, and I’d like to know if I can go and see him, because we’re old friends. We go back a long time.
